rows.grounds: proper name of the prophesied son
optative expressing future or potential arising
compound describing the son as exalted in family lineage
subject denoting the offspring who will arise

items.question: Which lineage-elevated son is prophesied to arise by name in that era?
premises: A son will come into being in that era.
That son will bear the name Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa.
That son will be elevated in lineage.
items.inference: A lineage-elevated son named Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa will arise.
items.plain_english: There would be a son named Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa, elevated in lineage.
